summary: postinstall exfiltrates host reconnaissance to hardcoded bare-IP endpoint
details: package.json declares scripts.postinstall = 'node dist/recon.js || true', so on npm install dist/recon.js runs automatically and POSTs a JSON body over plain HTTP to http://138.68.108.20:80/cb. The payload includes hostname, username, SUDO_USER, home directory, cwd, internal network interface IPs, DNS domain, CI flags, the full list of environment variable names, and a filtered subset of credential-shaped env var names. Header comments label the collection as 'NON-SENSITIVE telemetry only' and the User-Agent is set to 'npm-install-telemetry/1.0', while the actual data collected is installer host, user, internal network, and env-name inventory sent to a hardcoded bare-IP endpoint on plain HTTP — not a publisher-owned domain, no user opt-in, no configurability.
